title: Cloud-native diversity gets a boost by CNCF initiative - SiliconANGLE
summary: The article discusses the Open Source community's challenge with a lack of diversity among contributors and maintainers, highlighting the initiative by the Cloud Native Computing Foundation to address this issue through the Merge Forward program. It also showcases personal success stories of engineers who have benefited from the program.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is positive because the article focuses on the proactive steps taken by the Merge Forward initiative to increase diversity and inclusion in the open-source community, which is seen as a positive development for the ecosystem.
